reason: Both answers are largely supported by the cited pages, with only small stretches (X credits the gates-of-Hades reading to Iamblichus as well as Aristotle; Y adds hollow-stem detail to p.181 that comes from another page). Y covers more well-sourced points, including Pausanias on Demeter at Pheneus, the Flamen Dialis, the kyamotrōx proverb, Gellius's testicles reading and Aristoxenus's dissent, although it leaves a removed-quote placeholder in the text, while X ends with an irrelevant Agrippa image.
